about: Fifteen Days v5: Bai's 'What?!' as a turn, from the cleaned side-glance frame (the K18 'what' picture was flagged by fal's content checker). DRAFTED prompts. Second try: the first put her hand to her chin.

jobs.prompt: She takes one hand off the phone and reaches up to the headphones, pulling the nearer ear cup off her ear so it sits up on her head; her other hand still holds the phone on the table. Exactly two arms and two hands. Keep the drawing, colours, camera, framing and crop exactly as they are; she keeps her face, hair, vest, tattoos and her head turned over her shoulder in profile. Nobody else anywhere. No letters or numbers.
